title: Technician II Traceability, Metrics and Shift Handoff Record
description: A structured shift record linking crop or lot identity, production metrics, open deviations, completed work, pending checks, authority boundaries, and receiving-owner handoff.
instructions: Record the exact crop, room, lot, batch, or task identity used by the local traceability system.
Separate observed metric values from interpretation and corrective decisions.
Carry forward unresolved deviations, quarantines, maintenance issues, sampling, and verification tasks with a named receiving owner.
Document when the receiving role acknowledges the handoff and any new priority or escalation.
limitations: This record supplements rather than replaces regulated inventory, batch, quality, security, or employment records.
Site-specific identifiers, retention rules, signatures, access controls, and required fields must follow the approved local system.
